subject: Quote HAM-TLV
body:
Hi team,

please quote your cheapest rate Hamburg (HAM) to Tel Aviv (TLV) for 2 drums of resin, 260 kg, 0.9 cbm, ready 27 November, delivered to HAM by us. All-in in EUR.

Please reply in German, our shipping office does not read English.

Best regards
Lisa Wagner
Logistics
Elbe Chemie GmbH
